metric_contract.center_deflection: Signed final axial displacement in mm at (X,Y)=(0,1): Abaqus U2 or ANSYS UY; downward is negative.
metric_contract.max_stress: Final maximum von Mises stress in MPa: Abaqus integration-point S.Mises, or ANSYS saved nodally averaged S,EQV in SET,LAST.

visible_goal: Build and solve the specified axisymmetric circular plate with a clamped outer edge and top pressure; report native-result-bound center deflection and solver-position-specific maximum von Mises stress.
selection_reason: Axisymmetric plate statics matches the Abaqus-origin family and is cross-solver feasible.
